subject: eng
title: Grammar 2A Ch 1–3: There is/are, Modals & Feelings

questions.q: ___ there a computer room on the third floor? Yes, there is.
questions.explain: a computer room 是單數，詢問「有沒有」用 Is there ...?
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: ___ there a computer room on the third floor? Yes, there is.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 1–3: There is/are, Modals & Feelings

questions.q: Where ___ the toilets? They are on the second floor.
questions.explain: the toilets 是複數，疑問句動詞用 are（Where are the toilets?）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Where ___ the toilets? They are on the second floor.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 1–3: There is/are, Modals & Feelings

questions.q: You ___ wait for your turn in the computer room.
questions.explain: 排隊輪候（wait for your turn）是必須遵守的規則，用 must。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: You ___ wait for your turn in the computer room.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 1–3: There is/are, Modals & Feelings

questions.q: Look! The panda is sleeping. We ___ keep quiet.
questions.explain: 熊貓正在睡覺，我們必須保持安靜（must keep quiet）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Look! The panda is sleeping. We ___ keep quiet.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 1–3: There is/are, Modals & Feelings

questions.q: Keep ___ the grass, please. Don't walk on it.
questions.explain: Keep off the grass 是固定動詞片語，意思是「請勿踐踏草地」。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Keep ___ the grass, please. Don't walk on it.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 1–3: There is/are, Modals & Feelings

questions.q: Alan: I am hungry. Betty: I am hungry ___.
questions.explain: 在肯定句尾表示「也一樣」用 too（I am hungry too.）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Alan: I am hungry. Betty: I am hungry ___.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 1–3: There is/are, Modals & Feelings

questions.q: Correct the mistake: 'We mustn't climbing the trees.' -> We mustn't ___ the trees.
questions.explain: 情態動詞 must / mustn't 後面必須用動詞原形 climb。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Correct the mistake: 'We mustn't climbing the trees.' -> We mustn't ___ the trees.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 1–3: There is/are, Modals & Feelings

questions.q: Rearrange the words to make a suggestion.
questions.explain: Let's 後接動詞原形 turn on：Let's turn on the fan.（我們開風扇吧。）
questions.subject: eng
